source.title: More Moonroot
source.description: We still need more Moonroot to reverse the Nightmare Incursions. Travel through the Emerald Portal in Dream Bough and bring me back some.
source.objective: Gather 10 Moonroot in the Feralas Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Thank you. Your services will be remembered.
